description_en: Refreshes the container asset data in the asset center
description_zh: 调用RefreshContainerAssets接口刷新资产中心的容器资产数据
name: RefreshContainerAssets

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the Asset Type of the container assets to refresh. Valid values:
IMAGE: Container images.
CONTAINER: Containers
parameters.help_zh:
指定要刷新的容器资产类型。取值：
IMAGE：容器镜像。
CONTAINER：容器
parameters.name: asset_type

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TaskId.description_en: The root ID of the original container asset task. This ID is returned when a container refresh request includes a ClientToken, but it does not indicate that the execution is complete
TaskId.description_zh: 原容器资产任务根标识；携带ClientToken的容器刷新返回，不代表执行完成
TaskId.title_en: 原容器资产任务根标识；携带ClientToken的容器刷新返回，不代表执行完成
TaskId.title_zh: 原容器资产任务根标识；携带ClientToken的容器刷新返回，不代表执行完成
